text_block_list.text: WAAAAAH!
Gasp! Someone's in trouble! That voice came from the school gates—let's go!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
WAAAH! No... No! You're scaring me,
Nature! Don't come any closer!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I'm not scary at all! Come
here... so I can cover you in
mud too!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: WAAAH! It's a monster! Go away!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
What're those two up to? And, uh, why's
Nature all caked in mud?
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
Did Turbo prank her? Or, like, maybe
they're having a mud party! I
lowkey
wanna try that. ☆
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a mud party, huh? I heard they're all
the rage right now! Well... I
think I did
anyway. Maybe?
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
Real talk though—it looks super lit. C'mon!
Let's get dirty!
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text: Sounds good! I'm in!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text: Sup, Nature! Wahey! ☆
text_block_list.name: Helios and Palmer

text_block_list.text: Nobody invited you!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Um... What do you think is going on?
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
I haven't got a clue. But we should
probably call someone just in
case—
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text: SLAM!

So this is where you've all been... I thought
I told you to meet for a
joint training
session after cleaning.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
Geez, Ikuno, you had me shook! Those
were some serious decibels for
just
slamming your book. Talk about a literal
clapback! ☆
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text:
Дайтаку Гелиос. Mejiro Palmer. I believe
the two of you were assigned
to cleaning
duty for skipping classes and playing
around.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text: Well, I didn't want to ditch class. I was just feeling different that day and didn't wanna kill the vibe, ya know? ☆
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text:
Geez, you guys are hopeless. Guess I'll
have to show you how to act
right!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
Ahem... Твин Турбо. You, too, were given
cleaning duty as
punishment for running
around the room during class, were you
not?
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text: That wasn't a punishment! The vice president just asked me to "try and calm down."
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Then I apologize. As for you,
Найс Нэйчер...
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Why are you here again?
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text: I want someone to tell me that...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Ooh—I understand now, Dia! It's a skit!
They must be practicing a
comedy routine!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
Ah, that makes sense! Where's my coin
purse? I want to support them.
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text: This isn't a skit! Wait... Huh? You two...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: B-b-boom! Kita and Sato, mad props on the cleanup job aaand for joining the academy! Time for a welcome party—wahey! ☆
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text: Waheeey! Thank youuu!
text_block_list.name: Kitasan and Satono

text_block_list.text: A party? Really?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Certainly, a celebration would help ease
the tension of entering an
unfamiliar
environment. I agree with Helios, actually.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
Guess you really can't judge a book by its
cover, huh?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for going out of your
way for us! You're all so
kind!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for any trouble that Turbo and
the others may have caused.
Incidentally,
what were you two doing back there?
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
Ah. Um... Well, actually, we also got
assigned cleaning duty as a
punishment.
Ahaha...
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
Seriously? That makes us, like, total
"prison pals." PPs for life!
Woohoo! ♪
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text: So what did you do? Throw a BBQ in the schoolyard? Or maybe a skateboarding contest in the hallway? You're unhinged!
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text: Er...
text_block_list.name: Kitasan and Satono

text_block_list.text: No, no! They were definitely building an ocean! I mean, Golshi was making waves earlier!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
Or maybe they got sucked into one of
Marvelous's schemes. You two
okay? Do
you feel like your normal selves?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Eeeep!
text_block_list.name: Kitasan and Satono

text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't scare them, Nature.
Don't
worry, you two. Not all of us here are such
wild characters.
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text: Oh, Palmer! Thank goodness at least somebody here is normal!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
Oh, please. Normal's the last word I'd use
for Little Miss Mejiro
Princess here.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Mejiro?! Then you're from the same
family as McQueen?
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
But wait, there's more! Palmz is the
explosive runaway pro, the front
running
goddess! My super runaway bestie! ☆
text_block_list.name: Дайтаку Гелиос

text_block_list.text:
A-a goddess?! Академия Тайсен really is
incredible. The Umamusume
here are
literally out of this world!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text: Hmm... What should I do?
